narrative.overview: The supplied gold monogram and script emblem set the brand character. Forest green supports gold and pale text, while neutral product grounds let the actual bag photographs carry color and material. Serif display type creates a considered pace; compact sans-serif controls keep browsing direct.
keyCharacteristics: Straight rules and square interface geometry.
Real product photography with intact silhouettes.
Serif titles and concise sans-serif controls.

rules.name: The Brand Pair Rule
rules.body: Use green and gold together for branded surfaces and primary actions. Gold is a flat brand color; photography supplies the material detail.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Newsreader carries display, section, product and detail titles. Inter Tight carries navigation, descriptions, specifications and controls. Both fonts are embedded in the copied HTML.

rules.name: The Product Depth Rule
rules.body: Apply diffuse shadows to product cutouts, rather than to every interface container. Actual bag silhouettes remain the basis of those shadows. Cards and controls use borders or tonal separation.

rules.name: The Square Edge Rule
rules.body: Every component, border, card and divider uses rigid right angles. Radius is zero, including clip-path expansion into the detail sheet. The supplied circular logo is artwork and retains its emblem outline; it does not introduce rounded interface controls.

dos: Do use the supplied logo and actual product photographs.
Do keep every interface corner square.
Do preserve silhouettes with image containment.
Do maintain keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't invent prices, stock, founding dates or commercial guarantees.
Don't apply Shopbycdl tokens to the preserved original archive.
Don't shrink functional labels below 11px to fit a layout.
